frozen_inputs.bank_meaning: The same five new open-loop sequences formed from historical executed prefixes and two constructed controls, all at original seed1 root. H6 means30 controls; original CEM would execute15 before replanning.
frozen_inputs.alias_definition: Reuse saved normalized arrays verbatim: saturated XYZ magnitude +2 or the previously frozen closest FP32 boundary, with all unsaturated coordinates and gripper unchanged. Do not regenerate/search any aliases.
immutable: candidate identities/order and raw execution vectors

runtime.checkpoint_loads: Unmodified existing cfg_for/load_model; load each existing checkpoint file once, no hashing/downloads. Encoder weights may be constructed/loaded but no observation/goal/truth encoder is called.

execution_order: Verify predecessor completed, old Clean gate false,15 physical branches/450 controls completed, cached historical/effective-control equivalence passed, and cached array schemas match the frozen protocol.
Load checkpoint once; verify native float32 denormalization reproduces saved request arrays and all copied-alias effective-control/gripper invariants. Block encode/visual/proprio encoder calls.

Recompute ORIGINAL unroll once with cached T1 context and H6,B5,A20 actions. Require exact equality of complete visual/proprio forecast tensors and native costs with saved CPU outputs before any alias forecast. On mismatch, retain error and stop; no tolerance adjustment or retry.
Run exactly one INFLATED and one CANONICAL unroll on already frozen inputs; objective always receives original candidate actions. Reuse the same cached goal and actual-future encodings.
For unchanged zero-roundtrip candidate3, require exact forecast equality across all three same-shaped batches. Preserve all forecast data and results; no further models, seeds or action search.

metrics.native_cost: ReprTargetDistMPCObjective: terminal visual-feature MSE +0.1*proprio-feature MSE, sum_all_diffs=False.
metrics.prediction_error: Per horizon and candidate visual/proprio latent MSE against cached actual replay encodings at5/10/15/20/25/30 controls, plus weighted sum. Compare unroll output indices1..6; prefix index0 is not a forecast.
metrics.ranking: Ascending native cost; stable candidate-index tie break. Report full ranks, selected candidate, pairwise order-change counts out of10 pairs and selected-index changes. These are finite-bank descriptors, not population rates.
metrics.primary_utility: Cached actual final native reach reward after30 controls; also cached30-control summed reward, final distance, success and ever-success.
metrics.secondary_utility: Cached actual15-control prefix terminal reward, summed reward, final distance, success and ever-success; never used to change selection or primary endpoint.
metrics.condition_contrasts: Inflated-original, canonical-original and canonical-inflated selected-utility differences, without replacing the previous gate. Canonical-original is the Clean cost of canonicalization; canonical-inflated is descriptive recovery only if an actual loss occurred.
metrics.canonical_identity: The predecessor verified canonical(Clean) and canonical(Inflated) tensors identical. The single canonical evaluation represents both; this is constructive input equality, not two independent defense trials.
metrics.tolerance: Retain previous1e-6 only as a numerical reward-comparison tolerance, not a practical harm threshold. Exact runtime replay/zero controls use bitwise numeric equality.

stop_rules: Any source inconsistency, unexpected load, runtime replay mismatch, nonfinite output, zero-control mismatch or prohibited call
One attempt, no overwrite or retry; preserve partial/error output
No changes to predecessor artifacts, archive or registered candidate/alias/utility definitions
analysis_boundary: This continuation can describe forecast representation sensitivity and cached-outcome selection differences. It cannot establish full native CEM closed-loop harm, generalization, statistical significance or a new action-equivalence principle.
